# Data Provenance & Assumptions

**All data is synthetic**, generated by `scripts/generate_data.py` (seed 42, reproducible). No real company or customer data.

| Area | How it is generated |
|---|---|
| Traffic | ~95,000 users first visiting between July and December 2025, with growth and November/December seasonality |
| Sessions | Number of sessions per user depends on a hidden engagement score; later sessions shift toward direct and email |
| Funnel | Step probabilities vary by device (desktop converts best), channel (paid social weakest, email strongest) and returning visitors |
| Catalogue | 1,500 products in 8 categories from 320 sellers; long-tail popularity; log-normal prices by category |
| Orders | 1–3 items typical; free shipping above €49; ~3% cancelled, ~4% returned |
| Experiment | Users active 3–30 November are split 50/50 by a hash of `user_id`. The treatment's true effect is not documented here; it is estimated in the analysis. |
| Marketing spend | Daily paid spend for paid search, paid social and affiliate, derived from session volumes and cost-per-click assumptions |

**Limitations:** no page-level browsing, search or product-detail events; no latency or error data for guardrails; behaviour is stylised to demonstrate method, not to benchmark real marketplaces.
